summary.text: Kathy Staub is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Staub's career experience includes working as a museum educator and community organizer, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Kathy Staub lives in Manchester, New Hampshire, and graduated from Central High School in 1975.
She earned a B.A. in anthropology from the University of New Hampshire in 1979 and an M.A. in American studies from Boston College in 1992.
Staub co-founded the Manchester Coalition for Quality Education and the Manchester Foundation for Education and served on the Manchester Board of School Committee.
Staub won the Hillsborough 25 general elections on November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
Her 2023-2024 committee assignment was the House Transportation Committee.
